description: This file provides a class `DatabaseConfigProvider` that resolves the application's PostgreSQL connection string from configuration or environment variables, handling different formats and possible errors. It also defines a record `DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult` to report the outcome of the resolution.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigProvider
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for resolving the PostgreSQL connection string from configuration sources or environment variables.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult
classes.description: A record type representing the result of attempting to resolve the database connection string, including success status, the connection string, and any error message.

methods.name: TryResolveConnectionString
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve and normalize the database connection string from configuration or environment variables, handling different formats and errors.

methods.name: GetFirstNonEmpty
methods.description: Selects the first non-empty string from a list of candidates.

methods.name: NormalizeEnvValue
methods.description: Trims whitespace and surrounding quotes from environment variable values to standardize the database URL string.
